svg.title: Released pipelines catching up
svg.desc: Stacked step-area chart, 2018 to November 2026. 146 active nf-core pipelines: 105 released, 41 in development. The released share has grown fastest through 2026.
svg.text: Active nf-core pipelines by status, dated by each pipeline’s first release.
Non-archived pipelines only. Data to 26 November 2026.
